name: sunstack-workflow-v2
description: Editable v2 workflow: four design skills, four roles, and agent management. Requires sunstack-dev. Does not replace frozen v1.

interface.shortDescription: Editable four-role design and management workflow
interface.longDescription: Editable v2 workflow: design-specification, design-program, design-verification, design-review, practices-manage-agents, and Lead, Implementer, Operator and Checker roles. Requires sunstack-dev. Frozen v1 remains the default runtime workflow until base callbacks change.
defaultPrompt: Use practices-manage-agents to choose a helper's role, form and model, then commission, monitor, or assess its work.
Use role-lead to own design, workstreams, sequencing and inspected acceptance.
Use role-implementer to make assigned changes, product tests and associated proof.
Use role-operator to execute prescribed work and guided collection.
Use role-checker for explicit verification or independent review duty.
Use design-specification to preserve authorized Why and observable What.
Use design-program to define structural How against this specification.
Use design-verification to say how each requirement will be proven.
Use design-review to independently review this specification, program design, verification design, or four-document set.
